structure.unit: Tangible Personal Property, Machinery and Tools and Merchants' Capital

law.text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this chapter, any city or county wherein a manufactured home, as defined in § 36-85.3, is delivered or moved after January 1, and used as a place of full-time residence by any person, may quarterly prorate any property taxes which would have been collectible had such manufactured home been situated within such city or county on January 1 of that year.
